notes.title: The first demo update
notes.notes: [h1]First demo update is LIVE - black hole issue is fixed![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]First and foremost, thanks for all the wonderful reactions and bug reports! It really helped us tackle the critical problems. The most common report was the black hole issue, and good news— we fixed it! Furthermore, we improved the asteroid collision and water visibility, so you don't lose track of them as easily.[/p][p][/p][p]We're really happy with how the Curiosmos demo was received, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you!! It makes us extremely excited to expand the universe.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers & lots of love,[/p][p]Céline[/p]

notes.title: ✷ BIG NEWS ✷ curiosmos demo just DROPPED !!
notes.notes:
[p][i]It's kinda hard to believe that we just released it... but after checking it 8 times I can confirm with certainty; it's truly live! [/i]Curiosmos is actually out there in the world and finally everyone can play it on Steam.[/p][p]
I feel like I’ve been holding my breath for weeks and I can finally sigh from relief.[/p][p]The first public Curiosmos demo - our weird little space game is now yours to poke at. Pull some asteroids into orbit and see what breaks (hopefully not too much :'•)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048036/9dc2ee6122d27811e0279242131b86d7a674b126.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It’s still a bit rough in places (we’re still working on controller support for example), BUT it’s also full of love, strange little systems, cute planets and silly moments. I hope it will make you feel something ✧[/p][p][/p][p]I'm excited to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p]~ Céline[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: ✵ !!! We 𝐖𝐎𝐍 the WINGS Award at A MAZE. Berlin !!! ♛♕✵
notes.notes:
[h3][i]The title says it all: we 𝐖𝐎𝐍 the WINGS Award at the A MAZE. Fest in Berlin!![/i][/h3][p]It comes with a lil' shiny cash prize and a beautiful TROPHY. I'm still not over it.
[/p][p]The WINGS Award is given to games where women or gender-marginalised folks lead the charge. So receiving it for Curiosmos, a game I started building from just a tiny dream and a bunch of determination into a game being made by this awesome team, means the universe to me. ✨[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="600"][tr][td colwidth="600"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048036/6568abb758f0039b2009c29dd2a19e59c5fb9da6.jpg"][/img]
𝐶𝑒́𝑙𝑖𝑛𝑒 & 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑆𝑖𝑙𝑙𝑦 𝑆𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑠 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑒𝑖𝑣𝑖𝑛𝑔 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑎𝑤𝑎𝑟𝑑[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][i]Here’s what they said during the announcement (and yes, I almost cried):[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]"A sʟᴏᴡ ᴜɴғᴏʟᴅɪɴɢ. [/i]
[i]ᴏ̨ᴜɪᴇᴛ ɪɴᴠɪᴛᴀᴛɪᴏɴ. [/i]
[i]Tᴏ ғᴇᴇʟ sᴍᴀʟʟ ᴀɴᴅ ᴘᴏᴡᴇʀғᴜʟ ᴀᴛ ᴛʜᴇ sᴀᴍᴇ ᴛɪᴍᴇ. [/i][/p][p][i]A ɢᴀᴍᴇ ᴛʜᴀᴛ ʜᴀɴᴅs ʏᴏᴜ ᴛʜᴇ ᴜɴɪᴠᴇʀsᴇ. Lɪᴛᴇʀᴀʟʟʏ. [/i]
[i]A ᴘʟᴀʏғᴜʟ, ᴘᴏᴇᴛɪᴄ sᴀɴᴅʙᴏx ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ ʏᴏᴜ ʙᴜɪʟᴅ ʏᴏᴜʀ ᴏᴡɴ sᴏʟᴀʀ sʏsᴛᴇᴍ ғʀᴏᴍ sᴄʀᴀᴛᴄʜ: sᴄᴜʟᴘᴛɪɴɢ ᴘʟᴀɴᴇᴛs, ᴘᴜʟʟɪɴɢ ᴍᴏᴏɴs ɪɴᴛᴏ ᴏʀʙɪᴛ, ᴀᴅᴊᴜsᴛɪɴɢ ɢʀᴀᴠɪᴛʏ, ᴘʟᴀʏɪɴɢ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴀᴛᴍᴏsᴘʜᴇʀᴇs, ᴀɴᴅ ᴇᴠᴇɴ sᴘᴀʀᴋɪɴɢ ʟɪғᴇ. Iᴛ’s ᴛʜᴇ ᴋɪɴᴅ ᴏғ ɢᴀᴍᴇ ᴛʜᴀᴛ ᴍᴀᴋᴇs ʏᴏᴜ ғᴇᴇʟ ᴘᴏᴡᴇʀғᴜʟ ᴀɴᴅ sᴍᴀʟʟ ᴀᴛ ᴛʜᴇ sᴀᴍᴇ ᴛɪᴍᴇ, ʟɪᴋᴇ ᴀ ᴄᴏsᴍɪᴄ ᴇɴɢɪɴᴇᴇʀ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴀ ɢʟᴜᴇ sᴛɪᴄᴋ. [/i][/p][p][i]Iᴛ ᴡᴀs ᴍᴀᴅᴇ ʙʏ ᴀ ᴏ̨ᴜᴇᴇɴ ᴛʜᴀᴛ sʟᴀʏs. Aʟᴡᴀʏs ʜᴀs. Bᴜᴛ sɪɴᴄᴇ 2022, sʜᴇ ʜᴀsɴ’ᴛ ᴊᴜsᴛ sʟᴀʏᴇᴅ sᴏʟᴏ, sʜᴇ ɢᴀᴛʜᴇʀᴇᴅ ᴀ ᴄʀᴇᴡ ᴛᴏ ʙʀɪɴɢ ᴛʜɪs ᴄᴇʟᴇsᴛɪᴀʟ ᴠɪsɪᴏɴ ᴛᴏ ʟɪғᴇ. [/i][/p][p][i]Tʜᴇ ᴡɪɴɴᴇʀ ᴏғ ᴛʜᴇ A MAZE. WINGS Aᴡᴀʀᴅ ɪs… Cᴇʟɪɴᴇ ᴀɴᴅ ᴛʜᴇ Sɪʟʟʏ Sᴛᴀʀs ᴡɪᴛʜ Cᴜʀɪᴏsᴍᴏs!"[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The moment was incredible, I want to high-five the galaxy.[/p][p]I’m just so thankful... for the team (Robin, Guillaume, Chris, Tom, Titouan, Pepijn), for our community, for everyone who’s played the game and said something kind. For you!![/p][p]Buttttt, winning this award doesn’t mean the game is done. It just means the universe is nudging us forward.[/p][p][/p][h3][i]So what now?[/i][/h3][p]We’re still deep in development, sculpting oceans and atmospheres, tuning gravity until it feels right, and giving planets their weird little wishes.[/p][p]The game is planned to release later this year. (It’s real!! It's happening!!)[/p][p][/p][p]And I’ll have more to share soon - including our new Discord, updates from upcoming Steam events, and a whole lot more nonsense from the space corner. 🪐[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for cheering us on, whether loudly or quietly.[/p][p][/p][p]Sending you all a lot of love,[/p][p][/p][p][i]~ Slightly overwhelmed but intensely happy Céline[/i][/p]

📱 More TikToks! Here’s a little [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@celineveltman/video/7432004994213170464]LINK[/url] to the channel.

Many more things to do before this game is ready for the world. But by the time we finish Curiosmos, I bet the world will be ready for it.

Pfeeew we made it to the end! That’s all for now... Wishing you all a wonderful 2025, and hopefully, see you soon!

Lots of love,
~ Céline

notes.title: Curiosmos is a galactic playground of planet creation and creature evolution
notes.notes:
Infamous evolutionary flop Spore, for all its flaws, still had a lot of magic to it. It was fun to design your weird creatures, to watch them try to walk, and - in principle - to turn your humble creations into a spacefaring species.

Curiosmos is a very different game, but it has a little of the same appeal. It's a galactic playground in which you smash meteors together to make planets, then tinker with the ecosystems of those planets to make life and watch that life evolve. All while a hungry black hole lingers nearby, eager to consume everything you have created. There's an explanatory video below.

notes.title: We just announced ‘Curiosmos’ at Wholesome Direct!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today is a very [i]very[/i] exciting day. After countless hours of preparation, we’ve officially announced our super special darling space game ✶ [b]Curiosmos[/b] ✶ during the Wholesome Direct. Hooray!!!

Here’s the basic pitch: Curiosmos is a whimsical cosmic sandbox game in which you can build your own solar system crafting planets, moons, gravity, atmosphere, and even life! Embark on a quest to discover the secrets of the universe!

[previewyoutube=-hHasz4u_lg;full][/previewyoutube]

The game itself still needs more time in the oven, but we’re cooking and hoping to get it out into the cosmos sometime early next year. Until then, you can follow us here on Steam for regular updates. Be sure to wishlist, too!

That’s all for today.

Lots of love,

Céline Veltman & the Silly Stars
